fact.title: Training bond: the amount must be a fair estimate of loss
fact.claim: A minimum-service bond can be valid, but the amount you pay for leaving early must be a fair estimate of the employer's real loss.
fact.source: Supreme Court, Vijaya Bank v. Narnaware
fact.caveat: The case was about a public sector bank.

script.cover_1: A bond in your first job. Can the amount be anything?
script.payoff: Reports say the amount must be a fair estimate of the employer's real loss.
script.caption: A bond is a promise with a price, and the price needs a reason. Send this to the friend who signed one without reading it.
script.situation: Can your company charge a huge amount if you leave early?
script.answer: Reports say a bond can be valid, but the amount must be a fair estimate of real loss.
script.reply_me: Could you share how the bond amount was worked out? I would like to see the loss it covers.
